declaredOptions.label: Allow network access
declaredOptions.description: Lets the page load http and https resources; off keeps it entirely offline.

declaredOptions.label: Page to open
declaredOptions.description: The HTML file to open when the folder has no obvious one; relative to the game folder. execFile takes precedence.

declaredOptions.label: JavaScript
declaredOptions.description: Off disables scripting; almost every game needs it on.

declaredOptions.label: Require a tap before audio
declaredOptions.description: When on, audio and video only start after the player touches the screen.

declaredOptions.label: User agent string
declaredOptions.description: Overrides the browser identity the page sees; a few games branch on it.

declaredOptions.label: Web contents debugging
declaredOptions.description: Exposes the page to Chrome's remote debugger, for diagnosing a game that will not start.
